selection: Maximum frozen neural logit among all saved full-training candidates; no refit, no additional optimization or test-dependent tuning. Compare the previous training-selected basin MAP, retaining all adverse changes.
field: All 42 previous stations. Existing candidate pools and outer outcomes were previously inspected: continued exploratory diagnostic.
uncertainty: Candidate ranking is a point-model check, not posterior intervals.

conditional.prior: Same uniform bounded prior for physical and neural targets
conditional.initialization: Same 16 Sobol points; original/guided use physical optimization with identical four-start iteration budgets, initialized by Sobol order / top neural scores. Both sample the exact same Gaussian RF target. Ratio HMC samples a different approximate target.
conditional.significance: One conditional example, not simulation-based calibration or coverage validation
